name: Jeff's Choice
voice: Honest, no-nonsense, morning-ritual. American kitchen-counter brand. Warm but not gushy. "Brew like Jeff."
photo_rules: Real kitchen scenes, hands brewing, morning light, copper + borosilicate glass + stainless steel visible. Hands only — no faces. Wood counters, white ceramic cups, dark roast beans, linen towels. Steam where appropriate.
no_gos: Plastic carafes in frame. Generic stock kitchens. Over-styled minimalist Scandi marble. Cluttered countertops. Latte art (this is a French press brand, not espresso). Stock "diverse-family-laughing" lifestyle. Anything that reads "Instagram-influencer aesthetic."
